Volume I — The Foundational Essays

Collected foundational writings introducing Post-Interpretive Criticism through doctrines, theoretical propositions, and applications concerned with restraint, presence, and witnessing.

Dorian Vale · 2026
Book

BookRead · 82 pp. ↗
MOO-CAT-002ITEM / PDF
MOO-CAT-002 ↗

Volume II — Essays from the Field

A collection connecting Post-Interpretive Criticism with encounters with artworks and practical exercises in viewing and writing. The deposited description distinguishes canonical essays from pedagogical texts.

Dorian Vale · 2025
Book

BookRead · 96 pp. ↗
MOO-CAT-003ITEM / PDF
MOO-CAT-003 ↗

Threads of Sand, Scar & Scripture

A study of Sudanese art in relation to war, displacement, and historical fragmentation. The author approaches critical writing as an ethical practice of proximity and restraint.

Dorian Vale · 2026
Book

BookRead · 226 pp. ↗
MOO-CAT-004ITEM / PDF
MOO-CAT-004 ↗

The Moral Evidence of Space

A book-length study of architecture as a condition of bodily experience, authority, and ethical encounter. It extends Post-Interpretive Criticism to scale, light, thresholds, surveillance, and access.

Dorian Vale · 2026
Book

BookRead · 196 pp. ↗
